project_type: Python FastAPI app with CLI, content quality scoring using LLM + rules engine
verification_instructions: 1. pip install -e '.[dev]' 2. python -c 'from src.api.app import app' (import check) 3. pytest tests/ -v 4. python -c 'from src.core.scorer import score' (verify no broken imports after deletions)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No Docker needed (local dev project). No real LLM calls in tests (mock litellm).
contribution_requirements: 12 rules from .kiro/steering: Think before coding, Simplicity first, Surgical changes, Read before write, Tests verify intent not behavior, Fail loud, Match codebase conventions.
key_patterns: Pydantic models for data (src/models/score.py). Async LLM calls via litellm.acompletion. SQLite storage with manual connection management. FastAPI with middleware for rate limiting. Pipeline pattern with PipelineContext dataclass. Rules engine returns RuleResult with dimension_overrides and confidence. conftest.py needed for shared test fixtures.
directory_structure: src/ - main package. src/api/ - FastAPI app + rate limit middleware. src/auth/ - JWT/API key auth. src/cli/ - Typer CLI. src/core/ - scoring logic (scorer, rules, llm_judge, pipeline, config, hydrators, etc). src/dispatcher/ - task queue + retry (models.py, retry.py, task_queue.py used by MonitorService; dispatcher.py unused). src/extractors/ - web/text/file extraction. src/models/ - Pydantic models. src/monitor/ - MonitorService integration. src/preferences/ - user preferences CRUD. src/storage/ - SQLite DB layer. src/thunder/ - RSS/webhook monitoring. src/web/ - Jinja2 templates + HTMX UI. tests/ - only __init__.py exists.
